title: Synergies, Trade-offs, and Structural Pathways: A Directed Network Approach to SDG Prioritisation
summary: To successfully implement the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), it is necessary to understand the process by which the achievement of one goal has a spillover effect in a development system. While existing research studies synergies and trade-offs among the SDGs, most empirical approaches operate at the goal level, treat interactions as undirected, or prioritise indicators without accounting for structural redundancy.
